meta.name: ui-ux-pro-max
meta.description: UI/UX design intelligence for web and mobile. Searchable local database with 84 styles, 192 color palettes, 74 font pairings, 192 product types, 98 UX guidelines, 104 icon entries, 16 GSAP motion presets, and 25 chart types across 22 stacks (React, Next.js, Vue, Nuxt, Svelte, Astro, SwiftUI, React Native, Flutter, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Jetpack Compose, Angular, Laravel, JavaFX, WPF, WinUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, UWP, Three.js, and HTML/CSS). Use when designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查找 UI 样式、配色、字体和动效参考
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在设计或评审网页和移动端 UI 时需要灵感与规范参考。
copy.tagline_en: Find UI styles, color palettes, fonts, and motion references
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need inspiration and guidelines when designing or reviewing UI for web and mobile.

howto.what: Claude 可以搜索内置的 UI/UX 设计规则数据库，为网页或移动端提供配色、字体、样式、UX 指南等推荐，覆盖 22 个技术栈。
howto.when: 当你设计、构建或审查 UI（如页面、组件、配色、排版、布局、无障碍、动画或数据可视化）时，该技能会接管。

say.text: 帮我设计一个 SaaS 产品的颜色方案。
say.note: Claude 会搜索数据库并给出推荐色板与理由。

say.text: 我需要一套现代风格的字体系列。
say.note: Claude 会返回字体搭配建议。

say.text: 这个按钮的触摸区域应该多大？
say.note: Claude 会引用 UX 指南回答。

howto.what_en: Claude can query a built-in local database of UI/UX rules to give recommendations on colors, fonts, styles, UX guidelines, etc. for web or mobile projects, covering 22 technology stacks.
howto.when_en: This skill activates when you are designing, building, or reviewing UI: pages, components, color schemes, typography, layout, accessibility, animation, or data visualization.

say_en.text: Help me design a color scheme for a SaaS product.
say_en.note: Claude will search the database and return recommended palettes with rationale.

say_en.text: I need a modern font pairing.
What should be the minimum touch target for this button?
say_en.note: Claude will reference UX guidelines to answer.
